specific_objectives: 14.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the functions of AFCS.

Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of AFCS block diagram and Duplex Servo schematic; Instructor supervision required for schematic interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the AFCS?
Define a duplex system in the context of flight controls.
Why is redundancy critical in servo actuators?

development.content:
Definition of Duplex Servo Actuator
Comparison with Single Servo Systems
Basic Hydraulic/Electrical Architecture
Role in AFCS Redundancy

Operational Logic of Dual Channels
Failure Detection and Isolation
Load Sharing Mechanisms
Impact on Flight Control Stability

Maintenance Implications of Duplex Design
Troubleshooting Common Failures
System Testing Procedures
Integration with Yaw Damping Circuits

summary_questions: Explain how a duplex servo actuator maintains control authority during a single-channel failure.
Describe the sequence of events when the AFCS detects a discrepancy between duplex channels.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of duplex servo actuators apply to the torque limiting and phase advance circuits discussed in LP 38.

pft_rows.syllabus: Purpose and principle of operation of yaw damping circuit, explanation of torque limiting and phase advance.
